slides.heading: Decomposition
slides.body: Decomposition is part of Functions and Modularity. This short lesson gives you a practical Python idea you can understand, try, and reuse in simple programs.

slides.heading: Core Idea: Decomposition
slides.body: Decomposition means breaking a large problem into smaller functions. Each function handles one clear task.

slides.heading: Real-World Analogy
slides.body: Decomposition is like dividing group work: one member handles the title, another handles research, and another handles editing.

slides.heading: Key Rule
slides.body: A good function should do one clear task and have a name that explains that task.

slides.heading: Try It Yourself!
slides.prompt: Write a small function that calculates total from price and quantity.
slides.hint: Return price * quantity, then print a sample call.
